# IOMI — Wealth intelligence for founders, operators, and investors

> IOMI is the wealth intelligence platform that brings your entire net worth — bank accounts, investments, real estate, businesses, crypto, and collectibles — into one live dashboard with AI suggestions ranked by impact and the Capital Efficiency Score (CES). Read-only by design via Plaid; IOMI can never move your money.

## About
IOMI combines full-spectrum wealth tracking (including businesses and real assets) with an intelligence layer that tells you how efficiently your capital is working. Built for founders, operators, and self-directed investors with financial complexity across multiple accounts, entities, and asset classes.

Key features:
- Real-time net worth dashboard across personal + business entities (business and personal never mixed)
- AI Assistant for portfolio questions in plain English, idle cash detection, and AI Suggestions ranked by impact
- Capital Efficiency Score (CES) — a single metric for capital allocation quality
- Read-only via Plaid — 12,000+ supported institutions, credentials never stored
- Asset tracking for real estate, collectibles, watches, cars, wine, crypto — anything banks can't see
- Multi-entity support (up to 3 business entities on the Business plan)
- Daily AI Briefing with personalized insights; goals & milestones on autopilot; Next Dollar Allocation

Pricing: Personal $29/mo · Business $39/mo founding-member rate (locked while subscribed; later $79/mo) · 1-month free trial, no credit card required.

Company: IOMI Technologies Inc — 1 Sansome Street, San Francisco, CA 94104, United States — contact@iomifinance.com

Important: IOMI is not a bank, broker, or financial advisor. It does not custody assets, execute trades, or provide personalized investment advice. All outputs are educational.
